Arrays and data science

NumPy and pandas make Python the default for numeric and data work. Guion now has native arrays and a first-party data-frame library, frames, but both are young. In the project's reports on one Mac, the frames workloads took several times as long as pandas from reading a large CSV to the result, and Guion's array compute was still slower than NumPy's.

Earlier tests that reached NumPy through Python are retired and no longer cited. The array and data frame reports are in the repository's status page.
